business_hours_times_valid.name: business_hours_times_valid
business_hours_times_valid.value:
"business_hours"."is_open" = false
        OR (
          "business_hours"."opening_time" IS NOT NULL
          AND "business_hours"."closing_time" IS NOT NULL
        )

promotions_end_after_start.name: promotions_end_after_start
promotions_end_after_start.value:
"promotions"."start_at" IS NULL
        OR "promotions"."end_at" IS NULL
        OR "promotions"."end_at" > "promotions"."start_at"
